mechanics_notes: 300-Ki Awoken Skill restricted to the Frieza race. It transforms the user into Golden Form, changing appearance and substantially enhancing Ki Blast output. Current documentation lists +30% Blast Attack, -5% Blast Defense, and a normal Ki Blast sequence of 13 attacks rather than 15; charged Ki Blasts become a quick blast. The form is obtained through the Frieza race's Frieza Force progression. Exact transformation timing, Ki drain behavior, and every combo-specific damage multiplier are not treated as fully resolved here.
evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence only; unresolved numerical/frame details remain bounded.
